environmentBinding.meaning: EVIDENCE MUST BIND TO THE REVIEWED PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENT / NO BACKUP SYSTEM CONFIGURED HERE

evidenceStates.meaning: REVIEWED_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED IS BACKUP/RESTORE EVIDENCE ONLY / NOT RELEASE AUTHORITY

failClosedRules: This contract proves no live production backup, restore capability, recovery objective or retention compliance by itself.
Provider marketing, default service features, local dumps, disposable QA databases and CI database setup are not production backup evidence.
Backup evidence must bind to the exact reviewed production environment and enumerate the durable-store coverage it claims.
Missing backup automation, encryption, access-control or failure-visibility evidence keeps the production release receipt HOLD.
A successful production-readiness claim requires a reviewed restore exercise bound to an identified backup snapshot/set and target environment.
Restore verification evidence must not contain restored personal-data dumps, credentials, secret values or encryption keys.
Backup frequency, RPO, RTO and retention duration are not selected by this contract.
Retention/erasure composition remains HOLD until the applicable #69/#478 authority is reviewed and referenced.
Missing, stale, mismatched or UNVERIFIED backup/restore evidence keeps the production release receipt HOLD.
This contract selects no backup provider, storage vendor, cloud, schedule, recovery objective or retention duration.
